# h3_vm_placement_group (Resource)

Manages a VM placement group. Strategy `spread`: every VM of the group runs on its own host, so the failure of one host stops at most one VM of the group (database replicas, etcd, application clusters). A VM joins a group only when it is created (`h3_vm.placement_group_id`). The group holds at most `max_vms` VMs (the platform limit, never more than the number of hosts minus one, so that any host can be drained). `name` and `description` change in place; a group with VMs cannot be deleted (409 `PLACEMENT_GROUP_NOT_EMPTY`). Placement groups are free.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every VM of a spread group runs on its own host.
resource "h3_vm_placement_group" "db" {
  project_id  = var.project_id
  name        = "postgres-replicas"
  description = "one replica per host"
}

resource "h3_vm" "db" {
  count              = 3
  project_id         = var.project_id
  name               = "pg-${count.index}"
  cpu                = 4
  memory             = "8Gi"
  image              = "ubuntu:24.04"
  ssh_key_ids        = [var.ssh_key_id]
  placement_group_id = h3_vm_placement_group.db.id # set at creation only
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name (1-63 characters). Changed in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Changed in place.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID). Defaults to the provider `project_id` (`H3_PROJECT_ID`). Changing it replaces the placement group.
- `strategy` (String) Placement strategy: `spread` (the default and the only one). Changing it replaces the group.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Placement group ID.
- `max_vms` (Number) Maximum number of VMs in the group.
- `vm_ids` (List of String) IDs of the VMs in the group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by "<project_id>/<group_id>", or by "<group_id>" with the provider project_id set
terraform import h3_vm_placement_group.db <project_id>/<group_id>
```
